OBS statistics sources

Each URL shows one live statistic, chart, or complete battleplan reference card. Add it as an OBS Browser Source. Statistics are shared through Firebase. Timers update every second; score statistics update after the score is saved.

Text sources: use your existing Custom CSS. Charts: start at 1000 × 420. The battleplan reference card is designed for a square 1080 × 1080 source; leave OBS Custom CSS empty so its layout is retained. You can still manually refresh your sources after starting OBS.

Existing games may have incomplete history. New games track the complete game from the beginning.
